description:
In a match, Cristiano Ronaldo strikes the ball very hard and it flies into the stands, hitting a security guard on the head. The stadium goes quiet as people worry about what happened. After briefly explaining the situation to his teammates, Ronaldo immediately walks over to check on the woman. He asks if she is okay and waits until he’s sure she’s fine. Relieved to see that she isn’t seriously hurt, Ronaldo smiles and gives her his jersey as a gift before returning to the pitch. ⚽👏
#ronaldo #manchesterunited #cristianoronaldo #cr7 #football #edit #youtube #shorts #viral
